We need JUnit 4 imports, test class, test methods for each public method: join(Collection, String), join(Iterator, String), join(String[], String), padding(int), isBlank(String), isNumeric(String), isWhitespace(int), isActuallyWhitespace(int), isInvisibleChar(int), normaliseWhitespace(String), appendNormalisedWhitespace(StringBuilder, String, boolean), in(String, String...), inSorted(String, String[]), resolve(URL, String), resolve(String, String), stringBuilder().

Edge cases: null collection? join expects collection, but if null will cause NPE; we can test NPE. join iterator null. join with empty collection, one element, multiple, null elements inside? The code calls toString on each element, so null element would cause NPE. Test that.

padding: negative width throws IllegalArgumentException; width less than memoized length; width > memoized length.

isBlank: null, empty, whitespace characters, combination, non-whitespace.

isNumeric: null, empty, numeric string, string with non-digit, Unicode digits? Character.isDigit includes many; test with Arabic-Indic digit.

isWhitespace: test each whitespace char and non-whitespace.

isActuallyWhitespace: same plus 160.

isInvisibleChar: test known invisible chars (8203 etc) and others.

normaliseWhitespace: test string with multiple spaces, tabs, newlines, leading/trailing spaces, invisible chars.

appendNormalisedWhitespace: test with stripLeading true/false.

in: test needle present, not present, empty haystack.

inSorted: test sorted array, present, absent.

resolve(URL, String): test relative path, query, leading "./", absolute relUrl, also test exception? It throws MalformedURLException only if URL creation fails; provide valid base.

resolve(String, String): test valid base & rel, base malformed, rel absolute, both malformed.

stringBuilder: test that it returns empty builder and reuses threadlocal; test size limit.

We'll write JUnit 4 test class with @Test methods.

We'll need to import java.net.URL, java.net.MalformedURLException, java.util.*.

We'll use assertEquals, assertTrue, assertFalse, assertThrows (JUnit 4 doesn't have assertThrows; we can use ExpectedException rule or try-catch). Simpler: use @Test(expected=IllegalArgumentException.class) for negative padding.

But for other exception tests we can use try-catch and fail.

Make sure to test threadlocal builder size limit: we can fill builder beyond MaxCachedBuilderSize and then call stringBuilder again to see size reset? Hard to access private MaxCachedBuilderSize; but we can use reflection to get it or just test that builder is empty after call.

Edge case for resolve(String, String) when base malformed and rel absolute: should return rel's external form.

Also test when both malformed returns empty string.

Now produce final answer: start with method list, basic tests, edge cases, then final file with markers.
